bilder.name: hintergrund
bilder.prompt: Wide view of a medieval village square at golden hour: timber-framed houses, a stone watchtower with a blue banner, market stalls with colorful awnings, a windmill on a hill, rolling green hills and a dense forest in the background, a few villagers at work.
